gen-dafont-minecraftia-roboto-slab: Minecraftia ticks along one chunky character at a time, with wide gaps where its curves meet the stems. Roboto Slab, in contrast, packs a dense, structured middle band into each line, so shrinking the heading would let the body take over.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-rubik: Rubik's lowercase looks surprisingly big beside its capitals, and its round, soft letters stay clear at small sizes. Minecraftia adds a dark, sparkly texture on top.
gen-dafont-nasalization-bitter: Wiry, floating letters with a friendly bounce. Nasalization is best at drawing a light line with open, caliper-like curves, while Bitter is best at sturdy, grounded slab-serif text with a big lowercase eye.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with room around each curve. Nasalization is best at flat, thick strokes with short ascenders, while Bespoke Sans does its best work in a moderate, finely cut lowercase.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-glegoo: Flat strokes, wide-open curves. Nasalization does its best work with a stencil-like uniform line and floating letters, while Glegoo does its best with tall, editorial serif lowercase and generous counters.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hanuman: Friendly and light, Nasalization floats its letters apart with a single, constant line. Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase, would crowd the page if the body were enlarged much, while the heading stays happy small.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-kadwa: Nasalization bends constant-thickness lines into letters like neon tubing, with short ascenders and spaced-out forms. Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a generous x-height, reads smoothly over many lines.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, its curves entered through a visible stroke and lowercase filling most of the height. Nasalization keeps its horizontals as heavy as its verticals, and the body is the font to enlarge when more presence is wanted.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-pridi: Bent paperclip, basically. Nasalization earns its keep when it is big and brief, while Pridi, a classic serif with proud, almost capital-sized small letters, carries the rest.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-scope-one: Smooth wire lines, friendly spacing. Nasalization offers a flat stroke that never swells, and Scope One offers a traditional serif whose counters spill into the space around them.
